title: Reported AI-Generated Videos Depicted Former Kosovo President Vjosa Osmani and Other Public Figures in Allegedly False Compromising Scenes

behaviors.text: Videos reported as AI-generated depicted former Kosovo President a person, a person, a person, a person, a person, and Aleksandar Vučić in fabricated election-period scenes implying territorial-partition talks, an Osmani-Abdixhiku alliance, and opposition coordination against a person before Kosovo's June 7 snap elections.
